text.tspan: Whole wheat dough, black bean dip, whole beans, sweet corn,
mozzarella and cheddar cheese. Topped with shredded lettuce, pico de
gallo and avocado. Served with taco sauce on the side.

text.tspan: Imports PDF receipts from selected files/folders into the existing receipts table. It OCRs each PDF using the
documents tool, extracts structured fields via an agent, checks duplicates (vendor+date+total+receipt_number), and
supports two run modes: preview-only (default) or automatic insert. It also supports configurable duplicate and
missing-field handling, provides progress updates, uses batched insertMany writes, and prints a clear summary with

text.tspan: Imports PDF receipts from selected files/folders into the existing receipts table. It OCRs each PDF using the
documents tool, extracts structured fields via an agent, checks duplicates (vendor+date+total+receipt_number), and
supports two run modes: preview-only (default) or automatic insert. It also supports configurable duplicate and
missing-field handling, provides progress updates, uses batched insertMany writes, and prints a clear summary with
